We need to answer: "What are the birth years of the last five solo Pritzker Prize winners?" Need to list the most recent five individuals who have won the Pritzker Architecture Prize alone (i.e., not shared), and provide their birth years.

We need to know winners list. Let's recall: Pritzker Prize winners recent years:

2023: David Chipperfield (solo) born 1953.
2022: Francis Kéré (solo) born 1965.
2021: Anne Lacaton and Jean-Philippe Vassal (joint) - not solo.
2020: Yvonne Farrell and Shelley McNamara (joint) - not solo.
2019: Arata Isozaki (solo) born 1931 (died 2022).
2018: Balkrishna Doshi (solo) born 1927 (died 2023).
2017: Rafael Aranda, Carme Pigem, and Ramón Vilalta (joint) - not solo.
2016: Alejandro Aravena (solo) born 1967.
2015: Frei Otto (posthumous) solo, born 1925 (died 2015). However we need last five solo winners. Let's list solo winners in chronological order from most recent:

2023 David Chipperfield (1953)
2022 Francis Kéré (1965)
2021 joint, skip
2020 joint, skip
2019 Arata Isozaki (1931)
2018 Balkrishna Doshi (1927)
2017 joint, skip
2016 Alejandro Aravena (1967)
2015 Frei Otto (1925)
2014 Shigeru Ban (born 1957)
But we need last five solo winners: starting from most recent and counting solo only. So list: 2023 Chipperfield, 2022 Kéré, 2019 Isozaki, 2018 Doshi, 2016 Aravena. That's five solo winners. Wait also 2015 Otto is solo but that would be sixth. So correct five are: 2023, 2022, 2019, 2018, 2016.

Now provide birth years: Chipperfield 1953, Kéré 1965, Isozaki 1931, Doshi 1927, Aravena 1967.

We should verify via source. Use function delegate to lookup.
